lines: Māyā, you drown the knowing and the unknowing, blind to your greatness.
sanskrit_cite: tvagrudhiramāṃsamedomajjāsthimaye sadāmaye kāye | māye majjayasi tvaṃ māhātmyaṃ te janānajānānān

lines: Gods installed in metal-pictures — seeing them, 'alas, alas' cry the unfulfilled:
body-proud body-bearers — what folly does Māyā not mother?
sanskrit_cite: lohālekhyasthāpitān vīkṣya devān | hā hā hantetyāhureke'kṛtārthāḥ | dehāhantāśālināṃ dehabhājāṃ | mohāveśaṃ kaṃ na māyā prasūte

lines: From the all born of play-arisen, voided-mind, body-and-all I-making —
keep me from falling, supreme goddess, self-knowing-formed through striving.
Dread-natured, most dread, un-dread; named higher-and-lower, neither —
manifold-formed, Śiva's power: beholding, I rest in wonder.
sanskrit_cite: ghorātmikāṃ ghoratamāmaghorāṃ parāparākhyāmaparāṃ parāṃ ca | vicitrarūpāṃ śivayorvibhūtiṃ vilokayan vismayamāna āste

lines: Mid-rayed in high-and-low — no clutch of mine on is-is-not-is-not sayings.
notes: single-line sūtra-verse: kept whole, never split the echo-play

lines: Your matchless figure flashes — and the other, world-shaped, Mother:
both held in mind — to the good, fear-giver, boon-giver, highest goddess.
sanskrit_cite: sphurati yattava rūpamanuttaraṃ yadaparaṃ ca jaganmayamambike | ubhayametadanusmaratāṃ satāmabhayade varade paradevate

lines: Lady of five sports, knowing-formed supreme, Pārvatī — favor:
raise the fallen snare-bound one; lull the child with cool glances.
sanskrit_cite: parameśvari pañcakṛtyalīle parasaṃvinmayi pārvati prasīda | patitaṃ paśupāśamuddharemaṃ śiśumāśvāsaya śītalaiḥ kaṭākṣeḥ

lines: Bowing first to perfected guides, gods, goddess, then the seeing ones —
these fifteen verses were uttered by Abhinavagupta.
sanskrit_cite: pūrvasiddhān gurūn devān devīṃ natvātha yoginaḥ | ime'bhinavaguptena ślokāḥ pañcadaśeritāḥ
